//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the ORDERED-LIST component — the styled <ol> block pa-list-ordered (keen `List.ordered_list/1`, svelte `display/OrderedList.svelte`). SCOPE = CONTAINER ONLY. Like list.json, the slot receives plain TEXT (HTML-escaped by the dumper), so real <li> item markup can't flow through; the body is a bare text token. This fixture proves the container's tag (<ol>), its pa-list-ordered class + the style modifier, and its class passthrough. SIBLING blocks pa-list / pa-list-basic / pa-list-definition are DIFFERENT components, out of scope. Authored from dist/css/main.css + snippets/lists.html + _lists.scss.

propsVocabulary.style: marker style roman|alpha — emits pa-list-ordered--{style} (default = numeric 1,2,3, no modifier)
propsVocabulary.body: the list's item area — plain slot text in this container-only slice (real <li> children are out of scope)
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Structural. The container is a <ol class="pa-list-ordered …">. style emits pa-list-ordered--{value}; default numeric emits no modifier. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-list-ordered--'): roman, alpha. No numeric modifier (it's the default). body/extraClass produce null (structural/passthrough).

body.note: structural — the container's inner content; <li> items are out of scope

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature
